documents.title: NIH Roorkee — Standardized Precipitation Index methodology
documents.why: Authoritative Indian source for the same gamma-fit SPI method (McKee et al. 1993) this project implements in forecasting/split.py — it grounds the project's own methodology choice, not just drought in general.

documents.title: IMD Standard Operating Procedure for Agromet Advisory Services
documents.why: The actual government methodology for district-level agromet advisories — what a real advisory looks like and how it is made.

documents.title: ICAR-ATARI Jodhpur Agro-Advisory Services
documents.why: Rajasthan-specific advisory practice, matching this project's two modelled regions.

documents.title: Drought — model / region comparison
documents.why: The measured per-horizon drought skill scores, which the Synthesis agent must cite rather than invent.

documents.title: Heat Stress — model / region comparison
documents.why: The measured heat stress results, establishing that heat forecasting has no usable skill with this data.

live_sources_not_indexed.title: IMD Seasonal Forecast page
live_sources_not_indexed.why: IMD's seasonal outlook hub. Note: the page itself is a navigation hub whose extractable text is menu items plus a rotating press release marquee — the actual seasonal bulletins are linked PDFs. The current press-release statements are extracted; the manifest records this limitation rather than implying a full outlook.
